title: Admission scoring primary URL correction
summary: Continued the Stage B admission-scoring work from the prior Claude Code session. The fix keeps verified strategic lab URLs from being downgraded to intermediary when discovery came through HN or another aggregator, so primary-confirmed Anthropic/OpenAI/DeepMind-style engineering or research items can reach the main stream.

lessons.lesson: Aggregator discovery should not erase a primary-confirmed strategic lab URL.
lessons.evidence: The new admission scoring test failed before implementation because an Anthropic research URL discovered via a Hacker News-labeled source stayed out of the main stream; after the fix it enters the main stream and is not downgraded to intermediary.
lessons.recommended_action: When source authority is inferred, check verified primary URLs before applying broad intermediary-source regexes.

lessons.lesson: Direct Anthropic Engineering deep-dive ordering was already acceptable, so the implementation should stay focused.
lessons.evidence: The direct lab deep-dive versus AWS Bedrock availability fixture was green before source-level changes, while the aggregator-primary-URL fixture was red.
lessons.recommended_action: Avoid large score-weight rewrites until real draft outputs prove direct lab deep-dives are still being suppressed.

followups.action: Run a real dated draft with the new Anthropic engineering and research sources, then inspect whether the selected stories include the expected high-authority deep-dives.
Defer broader score-weight changes until a real artifact shows direct lab deep-dives losing to vendor availability or partnership PR after this source-level fix.
